metadata.description: A source-grounded 7-skill novel-to-game workflow for adaptation planning, building a candidate for the target runtime, and evidence-based QA. It supports systems games, interactive fiction and interactive film. 有原著依据的 7-skill 小说改编游戏工作流，覆盖改编策划、面向指定运行环境的候选版本构建，以及基于运行证据的 QA；支持系统玩法、互动叙事与互动影游。

plugins.name: novel-to-game
plugins.description: A source-grounded 7-skill novel-to-game workflow covering gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and art design, building a candidate for the target runtime, and evidence-based QA. It supports systems games, interactive fiction and interactive film. 有原著依据的 7-skill 小说改编游戏工作流，覆盖可游戏化拆解、概念选择、世界与美术设计、面向指定运行环境的候选版本构建，以及基于运行证据的 QA；支持系统玩法、互动叙事与互动影游。
